clue.text: Food I fed to soldiers, a Chinese dish

parts.note: chow is slang for food

indicators.note: something fed to a group goes into them, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: soldiers are men in the ranks
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone describes catering for troops by serving them a Chinese meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Food' looks like part of the definition, but it is wordplay; only 'a Chinese dish' defines, and 'fed to' puts the I among the soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Chow mein is a Chinese-style dish of stir-fried noodles with meat or vegetables.

clue.text: Talkative, spiteful about husband

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word wraps around the other

parts.note: catty means slyly spiteful
H is the standard abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A gossipy person is being nasty about someone's husband.
explanation.definitionFit: A chatty person likes to talk a lot, a direct synonym of talkative.

clue.text: Unfashionable group's origin

parts.note: out of fashion
a set is a group

explanation.surface: It asks where an uncool crowd started out.
explanation.definitionFit: The outset is the start or beginning of something, its point of origin.

clue.text: Kids lose them, helmet and kit, carelessly

indicators.note: things handled carelessly get jumbled out of their proper order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Children are always losing things, like their helmet and sports kit, through carelessness.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a descriptive phrase rather than a synonym: what children shed as they grow.
explanation.definitionFit: Milk teeth are a child's first set of teeth, which fall out to make way for adult ones.

clue.text: Especially popular individual

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
particular means individual or specific

explanation.surface: It describes someone who is a well-liked person above all.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase in particular is used adverbially to mean especially or specifically.

clue.text: Ancient city, she bet, is in ruins

indicators.note: something in ruins has fallen apart, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman wagers that some ancient city now lies in ruins.
explanation.definitionFit: Thebes was a major city of ancient Egypt, and also of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Building hospital overlooking river in York

indicators.note: in a down entry, a piece overlooking another sits above it, so it comes first

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital on maps and signs
the Ouse is the river that flows through York

explanation.surface: A building such as a hospital stands overlooking the river in York.
explanation.definitionFit: A house is a building, especially one people live in.

clue.text: Regular newsletter round home

parts.note: a round of ammunition is a bullet
at home means in

explanation.surface: A newsletter goes round to every home on a regular basis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Round' looks like a word for going about the houses, but it is a round of ammunition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulletin is a periodic publication issued by an organisation to its members.

clue.text: Shortly to provide worker to take another's place

indicators.note: shortly means cut short, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: to supply is to provide
the worker ant is a crossword staple

explanation.surface: Soon an employer will supply a worker to stand in for someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: To supplant is to oust and replace someone, taking over their position.

clue.text: Beast making social worker run away

parts.note: ants are social insects and include workers
to elope is to run away to marry

explanation.surface: Some beast scares a social worker into fleeing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' reads as a job title, but it is an ant, a social insect.
explanation.definitionFit: An antelope is a hoofed African or Asian mammal, a beast in the general sense of animal.

clue.text: Take to task, one way or the other

indicators.note: a word that reads the same one way or the other is the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: the phrase meaning to rebuke someone, which reads identically in both directions

explanation.surface: Someone is scolded no matter which way they turn.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull someone up is to reprimand or correct them, a phrasal idiom for rebuking.

clue.text: Avoiding an issue that is dividing small Essex town

indicators.note: a piece dividing another splits it in two, so it sits inside it

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small
id est is the Latin for that is, abbreviated i.e.
Epping is a town in Essex, England

explanation.surface: Someone dodges a question that is splitting a little town in Essex.
explanation.walkthrough: Most solvers reach for IE for 'that is'; here it is the full Latin id est, set between S and EPPING. Essex is a county just north-east of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidestepping an issue means evading it rather than dealing with it directly.

clue.text: Pay for another nurse

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to stand someone a meal or drink
second meaning: to give medical care to a patient

explanation.surface: Someone covers the bill for another nurse.
explanation.definitionFit: To treat is both to pay for another person's food or drink and to give someone medical care.

clue.text: Following lift, he will complain vociferously

indicators.note: following tells us the second piece comes after the first in the answer

parts.note: to raise is to lift
the contraction he'll

explanation.surface: After a broken lift, a man is going to kick up a fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lift' looks like an elevator, but here it is the verb to raise.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise hell is an idiom for protesting loudly and angrily.

clue.text: Thought of French emancipation

parts.note: de is French for of
emancipation is liberation

explanation.surface: It sounds like an essay title on ideas of French freedom.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberation is careful consideration, a noun meaning thought.

clue.text: One male in a shelter needed to make amends

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in places the preceding pieces inside the shelter word

parts.note: a tent is a shelter
taken as written
M is the abbreviation for male

explanation.surface: A man camping out has to make up for something he did wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Needed to make' is only the link; the noun 'amends' defines, and the opening 'a' stays outside the shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: Atonement is reparation for a wrong, the act of making amends.

clue.text: Informed cadet, due abroad

indicators.note: abroad means scattered far and wide, so the letters are spread into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A trainee officer is told he is due to be posted overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone educated is well informed, having knowledge from schooling or learning.

clue.text: Southern sailor has fish for bird

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for southern
tar is an old word for a sailor
the ling is a long fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A sailor from the south keeps some fish to feed a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The starling is a common songbird with glossy speckled plumage.

clue.text: At which prices are gradually lowered for lots in Amsterdam?

definitions.text: At which prices are gradually lowered for lots in Amsterdam?

parts.words: At which prices are gradually lowered for lots
parts.note: surface reading: describes a kind of sale where the asking price drops until someone bids
setter's reading: a sale of lots in Amsterdam would be held in the Netherlands, nodding at the nationality in the name

explanation.surface: It describes a sale where the asking price for each lot keeps falling, located in the Netherlands.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the Amsterdam setting is a playful literal reading of the name of this kind of sale.
explanation.definitionFit: This type of auction starts high and descends in price until a bidder accepts, as in Dutch flower markets.

clue.text: Popular figure playing well

parts.note: in means popular
a form is a figure or shape

explanation.surface: A well-known figure is on top of their game.
explanation.definitionFit: A player in form is performing well, the idiom from sport.

clue.text: Conqueror William's initial secret

indicators.note: initial points to the first letter of the word it follows

parts.note: the opening letter of the name
inner means private or secret, as in inner thoughts

explanation.surface: It hints at a hidden secret of William the Conqueror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conqueror William' reads as the Norman king, but Conqueror is the definition and William supplies a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A winner is one who conquers or prevails in a contest.

clue.text: Character cutting, a cheat

parts.note: a card is an eccentric or amusing character
a sharp blade is cutting

explanation.surface: A person with a cutting wit turns out to be a fraud.
explanation.definitionFit: A cardsharp is a professional cheat at card games.

clue.text: Transaction involving black fur

indicators.note: involving means including within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a sale is a transaction
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: It describes a deal in a dark-coloured fur.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Black fur' reads as one phrase, but black is wordplay and only fur defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Sable is the valuable dark-brown fur of a small Asian mammal of the same name.

clue.text: Boredom shown by nun, I suspect, after end of service

indicators.note: after says the shuffled piece comes later than the single letter
end of points to the last letter of the word that follows

parts.note: the final letter of the word

indicators.note: suspect means doubtful or dodgy, so the letters are not to be trusted in this order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A nun seems to be bored once the church service ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is a French loanword for listless weariness, a synonym of boredom.

clue.text: Endeavour to secure one pound for a hat

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast inside, so one piece encloses the others

parts.note: to try is to endeavour
the Roman numeral for one
lb is the abbreviation for a pound in weight

explanation.surface: Someone tries to get a hat for just a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: A trilby is a soft felt hat with a narrow brim and indented crown.

clue.text: Whistle along, then be quiet

parts.note: to pipe is to whistle or play a pipe
along, as in down the road

explanation.surface: Someone whistles a tune and is then told to hush.
explanation.definitionFit: Pipe down is an informal idiom meaning stop talking or make less noise.

clue.text: Followed, stubbornly determined

definitions.meaning: first meaning: tailed closely, as a dog trails someone

explanation.surface: Someone was tailed by a relentless pursuer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogged is both the past tense of a verb for tracking someone and an adjective for tenacious persistence.

clue.text: Miniature hourglass, for example — good orders brought back

parts.note: e.g. abbreviates exempli gratia, for example
G is the abbreviation for good

indicators.note: brought back means returned, so the word is read from right to left

parts.note: a remit is a set of instructions or orders

explanation.surface: It describes a small sand timer, with good instructions returned.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg timer is a small sand glass that runs for the few minutes it takes to boil an egg.
